title: Pod Salt Origin Menthol Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-liquid
description: Menthol Tobacco from Pod Salt’s Origin collection is a thrillingly authentic menthol cigarette flavour. Deeply flavoursome, hand rolled tobacco is given a breezy lift from refreshing menthol, making for a supremely satisfying all-day vape, especially for those making the transition to vaping from smoking. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit. Origin is an exciting new e-liquid range from award-winning e-liquid makers Pod Salt. As their name suggests, the Origin collection harks back to the birth of vaping, with astounding Tobacco flavour blends intended to help smokers make the switch to vaping as effortless as possible. Pod Salt Origin nic salt e-liquids’ premium nicotine salt formula is absorbed faster, lasts longer and produces a greater level of satisfaction than traditional Freebase e-liquid, all while tasting as deliciously authentic as you would hope. Nicotine Salt e-liquid’s unique alkaline formulation means that they can contain a higher concentration of nicotine than regular freebase e-liquids, all while delivering a smooth and comfortable throat hit. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, with nic salts the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing rapid relief from the peskiest of nicotine cravings. If you enjoy this flavour then there are several more delicious vapes to explore in Pod Salt’s fabulous Origin collection of nic salt e-liquids. From sweeter sensations like Liquor Tobacco to classics such as Virginia Gold, Pod Salt Origin e-liquids are flavours made to satisfy and delight every tobacco fan.
